cr_rule: A13: count per card number in feed order within the run; only posted purchases (amount > 0) count; checked after BR-01-BR-04; 5th and later -> 104; 100-104 rejects not counted; credits/zero never counted. Flags the card-vs-account reading (R-POST-104).
